title: Pilot Infrastructure & Client Context
description: Backlog P4. Structured, secret-free description of a pilot engagement's target SAP landscape and client identifiers, consumed as parameter input by the Unpack step (P5) and the Transcription connector (T3). Real credential values never live in this file — every credential field is a *reference* (an env var name or secret-manager path), resolved at Unpack time from the secure store described in README.md.

engagement.description: Identifies which pilot this context belongs to. No client-confidential free text here — this file is expected to sit in a repo, even though it holds no secrets.

engagementId.description: Internal engagement/project code, e.g. Jira project key or delivery-tracker ID.

clientCodeName.description: Non-identifying code name for the client (not the legal entity name) — keeps this file safe to reference in tickets/docs.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this context was last collected/updated.

sapSystems.description: One entry per SAP system tier the pilot's Unpack step needs to reach (typically DEV/QA/PRD, sometimes a sandbox).

systemId.description: SAP System ID (SID), e.g. DR1, QA1, PR1.

role.description: Landscape tier this system plays, independent of its SID.

host.description: Fully-qualified hostname or IP. Never an internal-only address without a note in `connectivity`.

ports.description: Only the ports the pilot's connectors actually need — omit protocols that aren't in scope.

authType.description: How the connector authenticates. Determines which secret shape `credentialRef` must resolve to (see README.md). `jwt`/`xsuaa` added for abap-mcp (SAP_AUTH_TYPE), found missing while wiring 301's context resolver.

systemType.description: Matches abap-mcp's SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE (controls which tools are available, e.g. Programs are onprem-only). Required whenever a connector in scope needs this distinction; abap-mcp always does.

credentialRef.description: Name of the env var or secret-manager key holding the actual credential. MUST NOT be a literal secret value — validated by the 'no plain-text secrets' acceptance criterion.

connectivity.description: How the factory's tooling is expected to reach this host.

btp.description: Present only if the pilot scope touches BTP (extensibility, Joule, integration suite, etc.). Omit entirely otherwise.

credentialRef.description: Env var/secret-manager key for the BTP service-key or destination credentials.

toolEnvironments.description: Which client tool environment(s) the Unpack step must target for this pilot (subset of the factory's supported adapters).
